01 / WHAT WE CAN HELP WITH

What could AI help
you with?

You don’t need to understand AI or choose software first. Tell us what takes too much time or keeps getting in the way. We’ll help you explore a simpler way to get it done.

01
Workflow automation

Less time on admin

Still copying details between emails and spreadsheets? We set up tools to organise information, notify your team and remind them what needs doing.

FOR EXAMPLEA new enquiry comes in
↓

Details saved → team notified → follow-up reminder

Spend less time moving information and more time helping customers.

02
AI business knowledge base

Find answers without the search

Ask a question in everyday language and find answers in your company’s documents, with the original source to check.

FOR EXAMPLE“How do we onboard a new client?”
↓

Find the relevant checklist and where it is saved.

03
AI customer support

Help customers get answers

Help visitors with common questions about your services. Pass enquiries that need a person to your team.

FOR EXAMPLE“Which service would suit me?”
↓

Explain the options and help the customer take the next step.

04
Custom AI tools

A tool that fits your business

When ready-made software doesn’t fit, we build a simple tool around the task your team needs to do.

FOR EXAMPLE“Can these notes become a report?”
↓

Turn your notes into a draft your team can check and edit.

05
Practical AI training

Help your team feel confident with AI

Learn with tasks from your own work: writing emails, summarising documents and checking AI’s answers. No technical background needed.

FOR EXAMPLE“Where do I even start?”
↓

Bring an everyday task. We’ll work through it with you.
